name: QEF Numerical Solvers
definition: A suite of linear algebra functions for solving Quadratic Error Function (QEF) systems and related eigenvalue problems. Includes Jacobi eigensolver, pseudo-inverse matrix inversion, QR decomposition, rank estimation, and L2 residual calculation.
summary: QEF Numerical Solvers is a lightweight linear algebra suite for solving small symmetric QEF systems in dual contouring, distinguished by its focus on 3x3 matrices and heuristic iterative refinement.
